ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 144

2. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 24

3. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

4. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

5. Solve for x: x + 9 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 4
   C. 13
   D. 9

6. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 14

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 17
   D. 1

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 43
   C. 41
   D. 49

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 122
   C. 22
   D. 121

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

14. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 33
   D. 12

15. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark
